result.summary: Configures macOS CI cross-compilation environments and Guix build scripts to treat linker warnings as fatal errors. It sets `-DCMAKE_LINK_WARNING_AS_ERROR=ON` in CI and passes `-Wl,-fatal_warnings` in Guix. It also activates CMake policies CMP0156 and CMP0179 (on CMake 3.31+) to deduplicate libraries on link lines, resolving existing Apple linker duplicate library warnings.
result.problem: Linker warnings on macOS can pass unnoticed in CI and Guix builds, allowing unintentional linker issues to go undetected. Existing Apple linker warnings regarding duplicate libraries would cause builds to fail once fatal warnings are enforced without library deduplication.
evidence: PR description: "Turn linker warnings into errors, so that any future warnings are caught."
Commit 50fb8fc483: "This silences Apple linker 'ignoring duplicate libraries' warnings."
result.scope_notes: Carries the commit from dependency PR #35756 modifying CMakeLists.txt to handle CMP0156 and CMP0179 policies alongside the macOS CI and Guix build changes.
result.changed_since_previous: Now includes the full diff, verifying the Guix scripts use -Wl,-fatal_warnings while CI scripts use -DCMAKE_LINK_WARNING_AS_ERROR=ON.
result.card: Treats linker warnings as fatal errors in macOS CI cross-compilation jobs and Guix builds to prevent linking anomalies from slipping through undetected. It applies CMake policies CMP0156 and CMP0179 on CMake 3.31+ to deduplicate libraries on link lines, resolving existing Apple linker warnings. The author notes this ensures any future linker warnings are caught automatically. This PR depends on #35756.

risk.why: A mistake would only cause macOS CI or Guix builds to fail if unhandled linker warnings or incompatible flags are encountered.
